name: delegation-kit
description: You choose the decision model — one of your cheap models, Levanto Sage, TypeSafe Jev, your own Dipylon or a local classifier — and it governs the models you already pay for: a local OpenAI-compatible router sends each request to the cheapest model in your pool that will get it right, with that model's own credential, and tells you why. Nothing dispatches without you asking.
